d: Short, chestnut brown hair is styled in a high ponytail with choppy bangs. A futuristic, translucent emerald green visor covers the eyes, concealing the expression and gaze. The face appears that of a late teenager with a slender, fit build. The outfit is a white, futuristic mini-dress with teal accents, featuring long sleeves with teal cuffs and a teal vertical stripe running down the center, paired with matching thigh-high white boots with teal trim. A pair of small, teal mechanical antenna-like protrusions extend upwards from the head.
